# A CAD book holding Hong Kong dollars its price database says nothing about.
#
# 1,000.00 HKD bought for 180.00 CAD, and no HKD price anywhere in the book.
# The cost bases know what those dollars cost — 0.18 CAD each, from the
# transaction itself — but nothing says what they are worth now.
#
# What this fixture is for: a balance sheet has to balance whatever it can and
# cannot price. GnuCash values an account it has no price for at zero, so the
# assets fall by 180.00; if the gain keys do not fall with them, equity stands
# 180.00 above assets and the sheet is wrong on its face.
#
# - 2026-01-02  1,000.00 CAD of opening capital.
# - 2026-01-10  1,000.00 HKD bought for 180.00 CAD — 0.18 CAD a dollar.
#
# No `price` block: that absence is the whole point, so do not add one.
2026-01-01 commodity CAD
	mnemonic: "CAD"
	fullname: "Canadian Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100
2026-01-01 commodity HKD
	mnemonic: "HKD"
	fullname: "Hong Kong Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100
2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: "Asset"
	placeholder: #True
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:CAD Bank
	type: "Bank"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:HKD Bank
	type: "Bank"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "HKD"
2026-01-01 open Equity
	type: "Equity"
	placeholder: #True
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Equity:Opening balances
	type: "Equity"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

2026-01-02 * "Opening capital"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:CAD Bank 1000.00 CAD
	Equity:Opening balances -1000.00 CAD

2026-01-10 * "Buy 1,000.00 HKD for 180.00 CAD"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:HKD Bank 1000.00 HKD
		share_price: "0.18"
		value: "180.00"
	Assets:CAD Bank -180.00 CAD
